# Why store-branching is never allowed, even with one store vendored

Distilled from the source repo's `web-store-whitelabel` skill — the one rule that actually matters when composing a page.

A bundle exported by `export-sandbox.mjs` vendors one store by default, or several via `--store codm,fcm` (see `AGENTS.md`'s note at the top if this bundle has more than one). Either way, the rule below is unconditional — it is not relaxed just because this bundle happens to carry only one store today.

### Source: `web-store-whitelabel` — "2. The golden rule"

**No component may test `theme.value === '<store>'`.** Store identity lives ONLY in the four
registries + the theme CSS. Components read **capability flags** and **copy** — never store names.

```js
// ❌ never
if (theme.value === 'fcm') { showPill = true }
// ✅ always
v-if="config.profile.showLoyaltyPill"
```

Verification gate (must be empty in `src/components/`):
```bash
grep -rnE "theme\.value ===|=== '(fcm|codm|[a-z-]+)'" src/components/
```
